question: I control Thorin Oakenshield and two artifacts, so I have an enduring story. My opponent then destroys both artifacts and Thorin, leaving me with no legendary, Saga or artifact permanents at all. Do I still have an enduring story?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: once you have an enduring story you keep it for the rest of the game, even after losing every storied permanent.
expected.answer: Once you have an enduring story, you have it for the rest of the game, even if you lose control of some or all of your storied permanents. The enduring story designation is on the player and can't be removed by any effect.

whyHard: Players expect the enduring story to switch off like a static bonus when they drop below three qualifying permanents, but it is a permanent designation on the player.
